business_summary.text: BLS E-Services is a leading digital service provider to governments and financial institutions in G2C, B2C, B2B categories through tech-enabled integrated business model.

call_points.text: Capex remains low due to asset-light model, with focus on technology investments
EBITDA margin under pressure due to higher cost of services, expected to stabilize with scale
Plans to invest in technology to build robust systems and processes for future growth
Actively scouting for strategic inorganic opportunities to complement existing businesses
EBITDA margin contracted due to change in business mix and entry into loan distribution business

timeline.summary: BLS E-Services reported FY26 results with 109.7% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,143 Cr, but EBITDA margin fell to 8.7% due to Aadifidelis acquisition; signed binding term sheet to acquire Atyati Technologies by July 31, 2026
